guideConstructionPrompts.prompt: Use case: image-to-image stylized game sprite. Input 1 is the original Early Medieval identity and equipment reference. Input 2 is ONLY the approved camera and painted outline style reference, not its era or costume. Create ONE complete squad in a single square transparent PNG, NOT a sheet. Exact vertical 90-degree overhead orthographic view, looking straight down helmet CROWNS, tops of shoulders and backs, no eye-level faces, no isometric tilt. Facing screen bottom. Five members in fixed two-rear/three-front formation. Original colourful detailed hand-painted game-icon style and bold dark edges, warm diffuse lighting. Keep every weapon visibly connected to the correct gripping hand, no intersecting shafts through forearms. Spacious clear transparent margins around ALL equipment, squad occupies central 65 percent including weapon tips. No floor, scene, ground shadow, labels, text, grid, outlines of cells or effects. EXACTLY FIVE men, FIVE steel one-handed swords and FIVE ROUND WOODEN SHIELDS with dark steel rims and central steel bosses, NOT Greek crested helmets. All have riveted steel conical nasal helmets, chainmail, brown leather bracers, boots, wool cloaks and belts. Rear-left dark red cloak and red/cream segmented round shield; rear-right olive-green cloak and blue/wood round shield; front-left blue cloak and blue/cream round shield; front-middle brown cloak and red/cream round shield; front-right ochre cloak and blue/wood round shield. Each identity preserved. Rear-left/front-left/front-middle sword in viewer-LEFT hand, shield viewer-RIGHT; rear-right/front-right sword viewer-RIGHT, shield viewer-LEFT. Every man has exactly one sword and one shield; folded shield forearm grips shield rear strap, never another sword. Ready idle stance, blades point diagonally downscreen next to their own outer sword arm, all five whole swords visible outside bodies and separate from neighbours. Full five shields are required, especially front-left and front-right.

camera: Straight overhead; every full squad faces screen-bottom
assembly: Selected whole-squad poses cropped from transparent sources, registered to rear helmet crowns, uniformly resized, and packed. No painted pixels edited with scripts.
selectionNotes: Infantry idle: eight complete groups from the irregular source layout; partial rightmost group excluded.
Bowmen idle: eight complete groups; clipped source slots 5 and 10 excluded.
Repeated pose indices in metadata are intentional holds.
Three infantry idle crops use inspected rear-helmet coordinates to avoid matching identical front helmets.
Cavalry: five horses and riders, five spears, four kite shields; front-centre leader has one spear and his spare hand on reins.
